entities.name: Errant
entities.description: A human rogue and graffiti artist affiliated with the Maestros family in New Capenna; daughter of Anhelo and Serena and wife of Parnesse.

entities.name: Anhelo
entities.description: Errant's father, compleated during the invasion; died in the explosion of Park Heights.

entities.name: Fiero Vespin
entities.description: A Maestro assassin and art dealer who targeted Errant and Parnesse's nuptials.

entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: Attacked New Capenna during the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Atraxa attacked New Capenna.

entities.name: Park Heights
entities.description: Location Errant tried to blow up; it collapsed.

entities.name: Giada
entities.description: Protected Errant unseen and ensured she was rescued.

events.summary: Fiero Vespin targets Errant and Parnesse's wedding.
After Atraxa attacks the plane, Errant's father Anhelo is compleated.
Anhelo faces Errant trying to stop her from blowing up Park Heights, fails, and dies in the explosion.
events.quote: He failed and died in the explosion.

events.summary: Giada secretly shields Errant and ensures she is rescued as Park Heights collapses.
events.quote: it was Giada at the end who ensured Errant was rescued by one of her sisters

relations.quote: She is the daughter of Anhelo and Serena
affiliated with the Maestros family in New Capenna
